content: The team learns vector spaces with count vectors, positive pointwise mutual information (PPMI), SGNS and uses column intersection (CI) and OP as alignment techniques where applicable. Then they compare two distance measures (CD and JSD) for the different models CNT + CI, PPMI + CI and SGNS + OP to identify which measure performs better for these models. They also experiment with different ways to remove negative values from SGNS vectors, which is needed for JSD.
